'''Chris Paul''' was a [[college basketball]] [[point guard]] for [[Wake Forest University]], and is currently eligible for the [[2005 NBA Draft]].

Paul played at [[West Forsyth High School]] where he was a [[2003]] [[McDonald's All American]] and named 2003 [[North Carolina]] [[Mr. Basketball]] by the [[Charlotte Observer]].

He was named the Freshman of the Year in the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] for the [[2003]]-[[2004]] season. Paul was named the 2004 ACC preseason player of the year & preseason national player of the year by the [[Associated Press|AP]].

Paul was named a first team AP All-American and was one of four finalists for the [[Naismith Trophy]] in spring [[2005]].  Shortly after, he declared for the [[NBA Draft]].
